title: MLINE-referenced simple LTYPE with sixteen ordered APPID XDATA groups

scope.source: Runtime-generated DXF; no repository drawing fixture is used or added.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0, alignment 65.
scope.xdata: Sixteen ordered group-1001 APPID names, each immediately followed by its distinct group-1000 payload. Names 1–8 use the retained named payloads from RPP-5uz; names 9–16 use provider-<index>-owned-xdata.

implementation.change: Removed the per-LTYPE eight-provider admission cap and fixed eight-slot arrays. APPID reference slots are dynamically sized after item-work and retained-byte admission; unchanged-state duplicate detection covers all canonical provider names. The effective upper bounds remain the existing global item/work and retained-byte budgets.
implementation.preserved_contract: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. This qualifies one selected AC1027 simple-LTYPE XDATA profile only; provider metadata, other payload compositions and application meaning remain unqualified.

proof.source: The generated source contains sixteen distinct bare APPID records, each owned by APPID table 0x1F0, with unique handles and exact ordered group-1001/group-1000 pairs on EditDash. Typed import verifies all sixteen providers and extData entries.
proof.output: All four ASCII/binary input/output combinations verify exact physical XDATA sequence, each emitted APPID record's qualified fields and owner, fresh typed readback of all sixteen pairs, and the retained LTYPE/provider source bindings.
proof.failure_retry: Removing provider 16 refuses export and preserves the destination in each of the four encoding combinations; restoring it succeeds on the same adapter. A late mutation of provider 16 after APPID emission refuses atomically; restoring its name succeeds on the same adapter with exact output/readback and all source bindings intact.

validation.asan_note: This platform's sanitizer runtime aborts when detect_leaks=1 is requested; the selector passed with halt_on_error=1 and no leak-detection option.

limits: The evidence qualifies sixteen distinct bare APPID providers, each followed by one group-1000 string, in one AC1027 simple-LTYPE XDATA profile. Seventeen-or-more providers, metadata-bearing providers, other payload orders/compositions, LTYPE schemas, versions and application meaning remain unqualified.
This proves selected transport and source/output identity only. It does not establish MLINE rendering, recursive document closure or general format support.
next: Select the next current distinguishing P2 geometry/schema witness or alternate LTYPE provider profile. Keep higher provider counts, metadata, other payload compositions and native rendering distinct; do not reopen the fixed-count implementation task.
